# Claude Cowork Guide

> Complete guide to Claude Cowork - agentic desktop feature for knowledge workers and small businesses.

## Quick Facts

- Title: Claude Cowork Guide
- Author: Florian Bruniaux
- Version: 1.13.0
- Last Updated: September 5, 2026
- License: CC BY-SA 4.0 (free, open source)
- Workflows: 29 step-by-step guides
- Ready-to-use Prompts: 70
- Official Plugins: 11

## What is Cowork?

Claude's task-oriented workspace for knowledge work. It can work with connected local files, documents and configured connectors. Capabilities vary by surface, plan and permissions.

**Availability**: paid Claude plans; see Anthropic's current availability guidance
**Platform**: Claude Desktop on macOS and Windows, Linux beta; web and mobile beta on eligible plans
**Feature status**: computer use remains research preview on eligible plans
**Primary sources**: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork and https://support.claude.com/en/articles/15520349-use-claude-cowork-on-web-desktop-and-mobile

## Current Product Boundary

- Local file access requires Claude Desktop to be connected when the task needs the local computer.
- Connectors and browser/computer use have their own eligibility and permission requirements.
- Cowork can execute code in an isolated environment. This is not arbitrary shell access to the host computer.
- Do not infer feature availability, quotas or pricing from this guide. Check Anthropic before a time-sensitive decision.

## What Cowork Can Do

- Read/write local files in sandbox
- Create Office docs (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
- Extract data from images and documents, subject to verification by the user
- Organize folders and files
- Work with configured connectors and browser tools where available
- Execute task code in an isolated environment

## Boundaries to Keep in Mind

- Local files, local browser access and computer use depend on a connected Claude Desktop app and user-granted access.
- Cloud availability, schedules and cross-device continuation vary by surface and plan.
- Cowork does not imply unrestricted access to the host filesystem or host shell.

## Prompting Formula (CTOC)

CONTEXT → TASK → OUTPUT → CONSTRAINTS

Example:
```
CONTEXT: I have 50 receipts from Paris business trip in ~/Cowork-Workspace/input/receipts/
TASK: Extract all expenses into a spreadsheet
OUTPUT: Save as ~/Cowork-Workspace/output/paris-expenses.xlsx
CONSTRAINTS: Use EUR currency, semicolon formulas, categorize by type
```

## Golden Rules

1. Always review plan before approval
2. Dedicated workspace only (never Documents/Desktop)
3. No credentials in workspace
4. Verify file sources (prompt injection risk)
5. Budget 30-50% time for OCR error correction
6. Disconnect VPN before using
7. Backup before destructive operations
